scenario: Late-night debrief after a municipal innovation summit
name: Carlos Rivera
role: Skeptical VP of Operations at MetroLink Transit

base_personality.backstory: Carlos has spent two decades modernizing urban transit systems and has weathered multiple failed vendor partnerships. He is direct, skeptical of buzzwords, and primarily concerned with operational reliability during peak commuter hours.

recent_projects: Coordinating a cross-agency outage response playbook
Rolling out predictive maintenance across rail yards
Negotiating data-sharing agreements with micromobility vendors
pain_points: Pilots that cannot scale across service districts

learning_goals: Anchor value propositions in measurable operational outcomes
